boundary_conditions: du_dxi(1) = 3 * reference_shear_stress * (bed_thickness / bed_modulus * (fouler_base_radius / (fouler_base_radius + tile_size / 2))**2 + skin_thickness / skin_modulus)

parameters.name: reference_shear_stress
parameters.justification: Mean shear on a barnacle base; linear model. u is the surface displacement under the base (xi from primer to surface, uniform effective strain), so u(1)/tau is the effective areal compliance including the load-spreading correction (a/(a+l))^2 with l = tile_size/2.
